interpretation.primary: Owner routing succeeded but application-config tasks bypass ongoing source convergence guidance. The system does not intervene when source discovery stops adding useful facts.
interpretation.informationGap: Precise location and token names are supplied, but actual stable theme token/cascade/preset contract is not exposed through a project-readable contract. This likely encourages tracing npm imports and provider hooks. It is not a mandatory technical prerequisite to attempting a scoped CSS override.
interpretation.promptRisk: Large general prompt includes Plugin creation/UI-stack investigation and responsive-repair confirmation/global-CSS prohibitions. These are conditional and do not forbid this ordinary project palette edit, but no short application-style rule explicitly prevents conflating them. Model confusion is plausible, not directly observed reasoning.
interpretation.notEstablished: Cannot prove enabling source fast path alone guarantees successful edits, or that any future CSS edit would pass verification, because no edit was attempted.

recommendedNextFixes: Apply focused source guidance to resolved application_config as well as plugin_source; preserve on-demand cross-layer discovery instead of a fixed workflow.
Expose stable public palette/token/scope/cascade contract via supported metadata or bounded package inspection, rather than opening all node_modules or copying vendor code.
Clarify that editing project stylesheet scoped tokens does not require new Plugin development, source takeover or responsive-repair confirmation.
Require concrete information gain for follow-up searches; after sufficient fresh evidence edit/validate, or explain a concrete blocker.
